Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. When the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases the wearer and their memosprite's DMG dealt by {dmg}.
For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by {same_target_dmg}, stacking up to 5 time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.

Increases the wearer's Effect RES by {effect_res}. If the wearer is attacked and has no Shield, they gain a Shield equal to {shield} of their Max HP for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every 3 turn(s). If the wearer has a Shield when attacked, the DMG they receive decreases by {attacked_the_dmg}.

Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's follow-up attacks by {dmg}. If the current HP of the target enemy is below 50% of their Max HP, increases DMG dealt by follow-up attacks by an extra {hp_increases_dmg}.

Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer uses an attack and affects no fewer than 2 attacked enemies with a corresponding Weakness, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by {turn_s} for 2 turn(s).

Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. At the start of battle or for every 4 instance(s) of Follow-Up ATK the wearer uses, the wearer gains "Umbra Devourer," lasting for 3 turn(s). While the wearer holds "Umbra Devourer," increases ATK by {devourer_increases_atk} and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by {dmg}. Effects of the same type cannot stack.
Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. The CRIT DMG dealt by the wearer's memosprite increases by {2}.
Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. After the wearer uses Skill, increases ATK by {skill_increases_atk}, stacking up to 3 times.
Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. For every different Weakness Type an enemy target has, increases the DMG dealt by the wearer by {dmg}, up to a max of 7 Weakness Types.

Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. When entering battle and if the allies' Skill Points max limit is 6 or higher, increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. After the wearer uses a Skill, increases their ATK by {3}, stacking up to 4 time(s).
When the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack enemies, the wearer gains one stack of Mischievous. Each stack increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}.
Increases the wearer's DMG by {dmg}. For every defeated enemy, the wearer's ATK increases by {atk}, stacking up to 3 time(s).
Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. After the wearer's memosprite attacks, the Outgoing Healing of the wearer and their memosprite increases by {outgoing_healing}, lasting for 1 turn(s).

Increases the wearer's CRIT rate by {crit_rate} and increases their Max HP by {max_hp}. When the wearer is attacked or consumes their own HP, their DMG increases by {hp_their_dmg}. This effect is removed after the wearer uses an attack.
Increases the wearer's DEF by {def}. Increases the DMG of the wearer when they use their Ultimate by {use_their_ultimate} of the wearer's DEF. This effect only apply 1 time per enemy target.

Increases the wearer's SPD by {spd}. When the wearer's memosprite uses a Memosprite Skill on an ally, gains "Blank," which increases DMG taken by all enemies by {which_increases_dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite uses a Memosprite Skill on an enemy, gains "Verse," which increases CRIT DMG of all allies by {crit_dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite has both "Blank" and "Verse," increases the effects of "Blank" and "Verse" by {blank_and_verse}.

Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {effect_hit_rate}. After the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack an enemy target, there is a 60% base chance to inflict "Unarmored" on the target. While in the Unarmored state, the enemy target receives {in_the_unarmored} increased DMG, lasting for 2 turn(s). If the target is under a DoT state inflicted by the wearer, there is a 60% base chance to upgrade the "Unarmored" state inflicted by the wearer to the "Cornered" state, which additionally increases the DMG the target enemy receives by {dmg}, lasting for 2 turn(s). During this period, the wearer cannot inflict "Unarmored" on the target.

Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer uses Ultimate, restores HP equal to {ultimate_restores_hp} of the wearer's ATK for all allies, and additionally restores HP equal to {additionally_restores_hp} of the wearer's ATK for the character with the lowest current HP, and grants "Redoubt" to all allies for 3 turn(s). Targets with "Redoubt" deal {dmg} increased DMG, which further increases by {if} if the targets have summons.

The wearer's base SPD increases by {base_spd}. When the wearer deals DMG, ignores {dmg_ignores} of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, obtains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of their turn. While "Blazing Sun" is in possession, increases the wearer's DMG dealt by {dmg}.

Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp} and Outgoing Healing by {outgoing_healing}. When the wearer heals allies, record the amount of Outgoing Healing. When any ally launches an attack, a random attacked enemy takes Additional DMG equal to {takes_additional_dmg} of the recorded Outgoing Healing value. This Additional DMG is of the same Type as the wearer's, is not affected by other buffs, and can only occur 1 time per turn

Increases the wearer's base SPD by {base_spd}. After the wearer and the wearer's memosprite attacks, the wearer gains 1 stack of "Brocade." Each stack of "Brocade" increases the wearer's and their memosprite's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}, stacking up to 6 time(s). When reaching maximum stacks, each "Brocade" stack additionally increases Basic ATK DMG dealt by {basic_atk_dmg}.

Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability, the wearer gains "Noctis." While the wearer has "Noctis," all allies' memosprites ignore {wearer_has_noctis} of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. Increases the DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprite by {dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite disappears, the wearer recovers {energy} Energy. Similar effects cannot stack.
After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. DMG increases by {per_point} per point of Energy, up to 160 Energy.
Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by {skill_increases_elation}, stacking up to 2 times.
Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the Elation of all allies by {elation}, lasting for 1 turn(s).

Increases the wearer's DEF by {def}. When the wearer is attacked, there is a {when} base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to {wearer_deals_dot} of the wearer's DEF for 2 turn(s).
Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by {turn_s} for 3 turn(s).

Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg} and Energy Regeneration Rate by {energy_regeneration_rate}. When the wearer's Max Energy is greater than 120, for every 10 points of Max Energy that exceeds this amount, further increases Energy Regeneration Rate by 0.3%. Up to a maximum of 360 points of excess Max Energy can be taken into account. When the wearer uses Elation Skill, increases the DMG received by all enemies by {dmg} for 2 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.
Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by {outgoing_healing}. When an ally target's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to 50%, increases the DMG dealt by {dmg}.
Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability on any ally target, increases all ally targets' DMG dealt by {ally_targets_dmg}, lasting for 3 turn(s).
At the start of battle, increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {effect_hit_rate} for 3 turn(s).
Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. When using Basic ATK or Skill, restores all allies' HP by an amount equal to {all_allies_hp} of their respective Max HP.

At the start of the battle, the DMG dealt to all allies decreases by {battle_the_dmg} for 5 turn(s). At the same time, immediately restores HP to all allies equal to {immediately_restores_hp} of the respective HP difference between the characters' Max HP and current HP.
After the wearer uses Basic ATK or Skill, the wearer deals {atk} of ATK as additional DMG to a random enemy that is attacked by abilities.

Increases the wearer's SPD by {spd}, and the Elation DMG dealt ignores {dmg_dealt_ignores} of the target's DEF. When the wearer uses Ultimate on themselves, gains {punchline} "Punchline." This effect can be triggered up to 1 time, and will be reset after using Basic ATK 3 time(s).
Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. Wearer's Basic ATKs restore an amount equal to {basic_atks} of Max HP plus 800 for themselves.

Increases the wearer's SPD by {spd}. When the wearer enters combat or uses Ultimate on an ally target, the wearer gains "Great Fortune" for 3 turn(s). While the wearer holds "Great Fortune," all allies' CRIT Rate increases by {allies_crit_rate}, CRIT DMG increases by {crit_dmg}, and the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by {energy_regeneration_rate}.

At the start of each wave, the wearer regenerates a fixed amount of 15 Energy.

Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. When the wearer deals Break DMG to an enemy target, inflicts Routed on the enemy, lasting for 2 turn(s). Targets afflicted with Routed receive {routed_receive} increased Break DMG from the wearer, and their SPD is lowered by 20%. Effects of the similar type cannot be stacked.

Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {effect_hit_rate}. When an enemy target gets inflicted with a debuff by the wearer, there is a 80% base chance for them to enter "Enthrallment," lasting for 3 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack. While the target is in "Enthrallment," for every 1 debuff applied by the wearer on the target, increases the target's received DoT by {received_dot}, stacking up to 6 time(s). When the target gets attacked by an ally, increases the attacker's SPD by {spd} for 3 turn(s). When the wearer gets knocked down, removes all "Enthrallment."
Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}, and increases their DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn or Bleed by {burn_or_bleed}. This also applies to DoT.

Increase the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate} and their follow-up attacks' DMG by {follow_up_attacks_dmg}. After the wearer uses a follow-up attack, apply the Tame state to the target, stacking up to 2 stacks. When allies hit enemy targets under the Tame state, every Tame stack increases the CRIT DMG dealt by {crit_dmg}.

Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. While the wearer is in battle, for every 20% CRIT DMG that exceeds 120%, the DMG dealt by follow-up attack increases by {dmg}. This effect can stack up to 4 time(s). When the battle starts or after the wearer uses their Basic ATK, enables Ultimate or the DMG dealt by follow-up attack to ignore {3} of the target's DEF, lasting for 2 turn(s).
